social_and_system_features.mechanic: Partnership created via 'The Golden Vow' item; unlocks milestones based on play time

details: Pre-invite feature for friends currently in-game
New Personal Profile and Name Badge UI

bug_fixes_and_optimizations: Vehicles can now honk in Classic Mode
Crouching/uncrouching no longer interrupts teammate revive channel
Teammate name opacity reduced when near crosshairs
Fixed hit registration bug where damage failed to apply
Optimized K character skill visual effects
Inhaler now heals above 200 HP for characters with extended max health pool
Bounty Token rewards now marked on mini-map
Clash Squad scoreboard shows live combat status of teammates
Spectators can view teammate equipment and equipped skills
High FPS option expanded to additional hardware models
Added 'Open Multiple Loot Boxes' bulk action button
Parachuting markers now display on main map during jump phase
Added unique audio cues for breaking armor/helmets and landing headshots
